name: PR439 M7 mutation proof

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr439-m7-order-mutation

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  mutation-proof:
    name: M7 rewritten test rejects inverted order
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Provenance
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          git log --oneline -3
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - name: Require target test to fail
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln
          mkdir -p artifacts/pr439-m7
          set +e
          dotnet test src/season-save/tests/season-save-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --filter "Name=ANewBanEarnedThisFixtureIsNotServedByThisSameFixture" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed" \
            --logger "trx;LogFileName=m7-mutation.trx" \
            --results-directory artifacts/pr439-m7
          test_status=$?
          set -e
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import pathlib, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
          p=pathlib.Path("artifacts/pr439-m7/m7-mutation.trx")
          root=ET.parse(p).getroot()
          rows=[e for e in root.iter() if e.tag.endswith("UnitTestResult")]
          target=[e for e in rows if e.attrib.get("testName")=="ANewBanEarnedThisFixtureIsNotServedByThisSameFixture"]
          if len(target)!=1:
              raise SystemExit(f"expected exactly one target result, got {len(target)}")
          print("M7_MUTATION targetOutcome="+target[0].attrib.get("outcome",""))
          if target[0].attrib.get("outcome")!="Failed":
              raise SystemExit("mutation proof failed: target test did not fail")
          if len(rows)!=1:
              raise SystemExit(f"expected exactly one executed test result, got {len(rows)}")
          PY
          if [ "$test_status" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "mutation proof failed: dotnet test unexpectedly succeeded" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "M7 mutation proof succeeded: exact target failed under inverted production order."
